li.label: a good omen
li.description: A good omen crossed my path.

li.label: a tale well told
li.description: A wanderer told a tale that I will remember for years.

li.label: blessed by the cauldron
li.description: The pilgrims' blessing sits warm in my chest.

li.label: haunted dreams
li.description: I keep dreaming of a red moon and a door that will not close.

li.label: ashamed of what we did
li.description: We did something we cannot take back, and everyone knows.

li.label: proud of our mercy
li.description: We chose mercy when it would have been easier not to.

li.label: dread of the demon
li.description: Something old and hungry looked at us and smiled.

li.label: grief for the fallen
li.description: The dead are not yet buried in my heart.

li.label: feast of lights
li.description: We lit lanterns for the ancestors and the night felt friendly.
